scores.rationale: Mixed common spirits; Adette brandy and old Benedictine have modest collector appeal, low fill levels and worn labels, about $40-80 together.
Campbell Launceston pottery is collectable locally but typically $15-40 a piece, with chips on two; about $60-90 total.
Mostly sealed designer fragrances plus miniatures; realistic resale about $80-150 in total.
Large box of 45s; Beatles EP and Apple single worth a little, rest common; bulk about $80-150.
Worn Frew Phantoms and Disney/Harvey comics are low-value bulk, about $30-70.
Common depression and uranium glass with some jadeite-style reamers; total about $60-100.
Three new Liberty shirts with tags; second-hand market realistically $80-150 for the set.
Company Caine and Buffalo are sought Australian LPs if original pressings, though Powderworks sticker suggests a reissue; mixed lot about $100-200.
Unmarked Victorian brown transfer 'Sydney' set, crazed and stained, bulky; about $60-120.
Dated 1924 oak box with mostly common sewing notions and a few better buttons; about $30-60.
